# hbctl

> Fast, agent-friendly Rust CLI client for remote Homebox v0.26+ REST APIs.

## Capabilities

- Inventory CRUD (`item list|get|create|update|upsert|delete|import|dedup`)
- Attachments (`attachment upload|list|download|delete`) with idempotent skip/overwrite, >500KB image guard, streaming downloads
- Search (`search`) with full-text query and `--tag`, `--model`, `--serial`, `--manufacturer`
- Typed custom fields (`field get|set`) supporting `text`, `number`, `boolean`
- Tag & entity-type management (`tag list|create`, `entity-types`)
- Filtered export (`export`) in `json`, `csv`, and `markdown`
- Compact JSON (`--json`), `--select` field projection, `--dry-run` (redacted `Authorization`), `--quiet` ID output
- Layered config: CLI > env/`.env` (`HBCTL_URL`, `HOMEBOX_URL`, `HOMEBOX_IP`, `HBCTL_API_KEY`, `HOMEBOX_API_KEY`) > `.hbctl.toml` > `~/.config/hbctl/config.toml` > defaults
